source.note: The implementation and protocol are being developed in this working tree; every run records its own metadata and hashes.

runtime.python_backend: not eligible; requires explicit legacy opt-in

test_id.used_for: held out; not opened in L0/L1

test_ood_burst.used_for: held out; not opened in L0/L1

test_ood_traffic.used_for: held out; not opened in L0/L1

budget.fixed_wall_clock_secondary: not run before L0/L1 selection; if opened, budget and accounting are registered separately

evaluation.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation total_cost_core; earliest checkpoint on exact tie
evaluation.per_day_pairing: same validation scenario index/hash for all arms
evaluation.heuristic_tuning: validation only; search budget and frozen parameters recorded before held-out evaluation

diagnostics.finite_check_cadence: rollout boundary and after each PPO update
diagnostics.failure_trace_selection: on finite/mask failures, first failing run/timestep; for quality diagnostics, the three highest total_cost_core validation days at each selected best checkpoint, using fixed scenario index order
diagnostics.instrumentation_rng_or_semantics: must not change; policy distribution is sampled without RNG at the registered cadence

acceptance.L0.1: protocol, hashes, runtime flags, inventory and ledger schema exist before quality runs
acceptance.L0.2: all required diagnostics populated or unavailable with an explicit reason; smoke and save/load checks pass
acceptance.L0.3: three complete core runs plus fixed/threshold/proportional validation on the same 100 days
acceptance.L0.4: baseline diagnosis cites validation data only and records one next-step hypothesis or KEEP CORE/STOP

L1_confirmation.paired_validation_ci: 95% day-bootstrap CI for candidate-control delta lies below zero
L1_confirmation.seed_rule: candidate mean cost is lower on at least 2 of 3 seeds
L1_confirmation.service_limits: registered before candidate trials; no post-score thresholds

historical_only: runs/diagnose-after/last.zip (missing L0 telemetry and full budget)
runs/runtime-optimization/full-reps/* (seed-11 runtime comparisons; no L0 telemetry and incompatible runtime defaults)
runs/rust-migration/full-workflow/rust/* (accepted R4 backend evidence; no L0 telemetry and historical config)
incomplete: runs/core-11/best.zip (checkpoint without metadata, config or complete results)
